title: swartzia amazonica var. cinerea
intro: Swartzia amazonica var. cinerea, commonly known as Brazilian tree, is a plant species in the family Leguminosae, known for its medicinal properties. It is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Swartzia amazonica var. cinerea include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic actions, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. These bioactive constituents contribute to the plant's ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity, making it a valuable resource for traditional medicine.
